text:
anna_ops: Scheduling a 'mini-wave' maintenance Thurs 03:30-05:00 UTC for az6/az7: NIC microcode + GPU host warm-reboot. Intention is non-disruptive rolling reboots, ~8 hosts/15m.
marc_sre: What's the expected hit to available GPU capacity? Need to communicate to the autoscaler and to sales for pinned-dedicated customers.
lucas_infra: Expect ~96 GPUs mid-wave (~2.8% regional). We'll never do full pool drain. Plan: 8 hosts -> wait 12m -> next 8. If backfill healthy, we can compress to 10/12m.
priya_oncall: For pinned dedicated instances we should alert CS and set a temporary 'no-evict' flag so those nodes aren't considered for backfill. @anna_ops can you enumerate the affected racks?
anna_ops: Affected: az6 racks 10-12 (legacy BMCs), az7 racks 2-3 (newer). We'll avoid evicting pinned capacity by labeling nodes `no-evict=true` before cordon.
marc_sre: Autoscaler config change: flip from "aggressive" to "warm-backfill" at T-10m. Also set scale-up cooldown to 15m to avoid spinning GPUs unnecessarily.
lucas_infra: Run commands in runbook: ```for n in $(cat cohort-nodes.txt); do kubectl label node $n maintenance.minor=true; kubectl cordon $n; kubectl drain $n --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60; done``` then trigger host reboot via vmctrl.
priya_oncall: Netops note: inter-az KV reseed historically fires extra egress. We'll enable temporary egress cap at 130% baseline, and netpol rate-limits for non-critical telemetry to reduce noise.
anna_ops: Cost estimate: If autoscaler briefly overshoots we might see a 20-25% GPTU cost bump for the 30m of peak replacement. We'll monitor and kill stray nodes.
marc_sre: Add a metric alert: if p95 token latency > 250ms for 3 consecutive minutes OR error rate > 0.6% then abort cohort and reverse. Oncall gets paged.
priya_oncall: Also: if cross-region failover triggers (we route to eu-west) escalate to infra lead; we want to avoid large customer-facing failovers.
ops-bot: maintenance created: 1780001111-mini-wave-az6-az7. Calendar invite + runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/mini-wave-1780001111
status-bot: status page update scheduled 30m prior to start. Link: https://status.redwood/incident/1780001111
lucas_infra: Note about legacy BMCs in az6 racks 10-12: some take 7-9 minutes to respond after power cycle. We will stagger these racks to prevent overlapping slow boots.
anna_ops: Sequence updated: start az7 racks (faster BMC) then az6 racks 10-12. Cohort windows: 03:30 az7-cohort-1, 03:45 az7-cohort-2, 04:00 az6-cohort-1, 04:15 az6-cohort-2.
marc_sre: Can someone run a quick dry-run tonight: cordon + drain on a single test host to validate kv-cache reseed and prefix warmup times? We saw a 90s reseed spike in previous ops.
priya_oncall: I'll run dry-run at 22:00 UTC and post metrics. Oncall will be standing by.
marc_sre: For telemetry: tag maintenance nodes with `maintenance_wave=1780001111` and `maintenance_type=mini-wave` before cordon so queries can filter cost/latency.
anna_ops: Customer message draft: "Planned rolling maintenance in region XYZ (az6/az7) on Thu 03:30-05:00 UTC. There may be brief, localized increases in latency as traffic warms to secondary pools. No API changes expected. If you rely on pinned capacity, contact support prior to the window." Approve?
lucas_infra: LGTM. Add status page link and support contact info.
marc_sre: After the wave we'll run a 10m canary at 5% traffic, then revert label `maintenance.minor` and remove `no-evict` flags.
ops-bot: deploy-batch: infra-mini/1780001111 -> cohort-az7-1 booked, ETA 03:30 UTC.
priya_oncall: Dry-run results: small kv reseed burst ~70-80s, p95 climbed from 85ms -> 140ms, tails rare. No errors. I'll upload charts.
marc_sre: Good. Proceed with plan. I'll stand by to flip autoscaler policy and pause aggressive scaling.
anna_ops: Final: status page + customers notified. I'll post start/finish messages in #customer-success. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
